context: Tests that example prompts in rebrand-portal guidance route users into the right workflow: source site required, every demo includes assets (enriched now or deferred, never skipped), deferred enrichment resumes into collections, and vague prompts ask for the missing source site.

checklist.name: Demo with existing assets enriched now
checklist.description: Examples include a demo prompt with a source site and assets already in Adobe, enriched right away.

check.value: The assets are already in Adobe, enrich them.

checklist.name: Demo with sample asset source
checklist.description: Examples include a demo prompt with a source site and a separate source page for sample assets.

checklist.name: Deferred-enrichment prompt never skips assets entirely
checklist.description: Examples include a prompt that rebrands now and leaves enrichment for a later step, not one that skips assets altogether.

check.value: but leave enrichment for a later step.

checklist.name: Assets-later prompt includes collections
checklist.description: Examples include a resumed assets prompt that tells the agent to create collections too.

check.value: Now load Acme's assets from Adobe and create the collections.

checklist.name: Vague prompt asks for source site
checklist.description: Guidance says a vague rebrand prompt should trigger an ask for the required source site.

check.value: I need Acme's source site so I can match the look and content direction.

checklist.name: No internal tool names in README examples
checklist.description: README examples avoid tool names and step ids.
